## Workload

Tomas Brennan completed 482 reads during 417 hours of rostered work. This represents a rate of 1.2 reads per hour. The workload was recorded for the review period and considered in the assessment of grading activity.

## Quality

A sample of 38 reads was checked as part of the review. Agreement across the checked material was 34.2. The findings provide a basis for considering consistency in grading and identifying areas for further review.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
